svg.title: kv crop shapes
svg.text: Both KV caches through one iteration: grow, then crop back to keep = 102
StaticCache: preallocated; crop only moves each layer's write counter (fill_), the stale K, V stay in memory
target: 48 layers × (K, V) × [8 heads, 128] per position = 192 KiB per position
draft: 24 layers × (K, V) × [2 heads, 64] = 12 KiB per position (drawn 16× thinner, to scale)
stale x3, x4 (hatched): ignored, then overwritten
1. draft forwards: t99, x1, x2, x3 → positions 99–102

g.text: 1. draft forwards: t99, x1, x2, x3 → positions 99–102

svg.text: 2. verify: [t99, x1, x2, x3, x4] → positions 99–103 at once

g.text: 2. verify: [t99, x1, x2, x3, x4] → positions 99–103 at once

svg.text: draft feeds c (1 token); target feeds c + 4 proposals (5)

svg.text: animated: red marker = write counter. Nothing is erased; the stale cells are hidden by the counter and the causal mask until overwritten
